en.headline: ICAC charges former HKEX vice-president and mother over confidential access
en.dek: Geoffrey Tong and his mother face one count of dishonest computer access after share trades yielded profits exceeding HK$500,000, the ICAC said.
body: The Independent Commission Against Corruption charged former Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing vice-president Geoffrey Tong Po-hang, 39, and his mother Leung Yiu-chun, 68, on Wednesday with one count of obtaining access to a computer with a view to dishonest gain.

The ICAC said the pair allegedly accessed the exchange’s internal information system between February 2018 and April 2023. Tong was said to have obtained confidential details of listed companies unrelated to his duties on multiple occasions. His mother’s investment account later traded shares in those companies, generating profits of more than HK$500,000.

The case arose from a corruption complaint referred by the Securities and Futures Commission. The two appeared at Eastern Magistrates’ Courts for mention on Wednesday afternoon. The ICAC said the investigation remained ongoing and further prosecutions had not been ruled out. The exchange has provided full assistance.

zh.headline: 廉署起訴前港交所副總裁及其母親涉不誠實取用內部系統
zh.dek: 董柏涵與母親梁耀珍被控一項為不誠實目的取用電腦罪，其後股票交易獲利逾50萬港元，廉署表示。
body: 廉政公署周三起訴香港交易所前副總裁董柏涵（39歲）及其母親梁耀珍（68歲），控以一項為不誠實目的而取用電腦罪。
廉署表示，兩人涉嫌於2018年2月至2023年4月期間取用交易所內部資訊系統。董柏涵多次取用與其職務無關的上市公司機密資料。其後，其母親的投資帳戶進行相關股份交易，獲利超過50萬港元。
案件源於證券及期貨事務監察委員會轉介的貪污投訴。兩人周三下午在東區裁判法院提堂。廉署指調查仍在進行，不排除進一步起訴。交易所已提供全面協助。
